name: KEB
recent: KEB Berhad 于2026年11月16日在马来西亚交易所ACE市场上市，通过IPO筹集约RM48.49百万。上市后，董事和大股东在闭市期间进行了股份交易。公司近期发布了季度财报。
notable: 公司于2026年11月16日在ACE市场上市，IPO发行价为RM0.35，筹集RM48.49百万。
董事经理Datuk Lim Kim Chong在2026年11月17日和18日分别增持3,810,000股和2,870,000股。
公司发布截至2026年9月30日止季度的合并业绩。
risks: 董事及大股东在闭市期间进行了股份交易，包括增持。
IPO涉及新股发行和现有股份的发售，可能导致股权摊薄。

recent_en: KEB Berhad listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia on 16 November 2026, raising approximately RM48.49 million from its IPO. After listing, directors and substantial shareholders traded shares during the closed period. The company recently released its quarterly financial results.
notable_en: The company listed on the ACE Market on 16 November 2026 at an IPO price of RM0.35, raising RM48.49 million.
Managing Director Datuk Lim Kim Chong acquired 3,810,000 shares and 2,870,000 shares on 17 and 18 November 2026, respectively.
The company released its consolidated results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026.
risks_en: Directors and substantial shareholders traded shares during the closed period, including acquisitions.
The IPO involved new share issuance and offer for sale of existing shares, which may lead to shareholding dilution.
